questions.question: Which important event that started in 1930 played a significant role in motivating and mobilizing Indians to join the non-violent movement for independence?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Salt Satyagraha**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Salt Satyagraha** was a significant event in India's struggle for independence, initiated by Mahatma Gandhi in 1930.
 
• This non-violent protest against the British salt tax mobilized millions of Indians to join the independence movement.
 
• The movement began with the Dandi March, where Gandhi and his followers marched 240 miles to the Arabian Sea to make their own salt, defying British laws.
 
• The Salt Satyagraha highlighted the unjust nature of British rule and united people across different regions and communities in India.
 
• This event is considered a pivotal moment in the Indian independence movement, showcasing the power of non-violent civil disobedience.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Salt Satyagraha** was part of the larger Civil Disobedience Movement, which sought to challenge various British laws and policies through non-violent means.
 
• Mahatma Gandhi's philosophy of **Satyagraha**, or non-violent resistance, inspired similar movements worldwide, including the American Civil Rights Movement led by Martin Luther King Jr.
 
• The success of the Salt Satyagraha demonstrated the potential of mass mobilization and civil disobedience as effective tools for political change.
 
• The movement significantly weakened British authority in India and paved the way for future campaigns leading up to India's independence in 1947.
 
• The Salt March remains a symbol of the Indian struggle for freedom and the power of peaceful protest.

questions.question: Where is the largest football stadium in India located?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Kolkata**__

__
 
• **Kolkata** is home to the largest football stadium in India, known as the Salt Lake Stadium or officially the Vivekananda Yuba Bharati Krirangan.
 
• The stadium has a seating capacity of around **85,000 spectators** after renovations, making it one of the largest football stadiums in the world.
 
• It was inaugurated in **1984** and has since hosted numerous national and international football matches, including the FIFA U-17 World Cup in 2017.
 
• The stadium is a multi-purpose venue but is primarily used for football matches and athletic events.
 
• It is the home ground for prominent football clubs like ATK Mohun Bagan and East Bengal FC.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Salt Lake Stadium was the largest football stadium in the world before its capacity was reduced from over 120,000 to 85,000 for safety and comfort reasons.
 
• The stadium has also hosted other events like concerts and political rallies.
 
• It is named after Swami Vivekananda, a key figure in the introduction of Indian philosophies of Vedanta and Yoga to the Western world.
 
• The stadium complex includes facilities for various other sports like athletics, swimming, and volleyball.
 
• It has been a crucial venue for promoting and developing football in India, contributing significantly to the sport's growth in the region.

questions.question: Annamacharya composed Sankirtans in praise of which God?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Lord Venkateshwara**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Annamacharya** composed Sankirtans primarily in praise of **Lord Venkateshwara**.
 
• Annamacharya, also known as **Tallapaka Annamacharya**, was a 15th-century Hindu saint and the earliest known Indian musician to compose songs called **Sankirtanas**.
 
• His compositions are considered to be among the finest in Telugu literature and are dedicated to the deity of **Tirumala Venkateswara Temple**.
 
• Annamacharya is regarded as the **pioneer of the Telugu keerthana** and a significant figure in the **Bhakti movement**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Annamacharya is believed to have composed over **32,000 Sankirtanas**, though only about 12,000 are available today.
 
• His works are preserved in the form of copper plates, which were hidden for centuries in a rock-built cell called the **Sankeertana Bhandaram** at the Tirumala temple.
 
• These compositions are sung even today in the **Tirumala temple** and other Venkateswara temples around the world.
 
• The themes of his songs often revolve around **devotion, morality, and the greatness of Lord Venkateshwara**.

questions.question: All historical monuments have signages with instructions that public should not write on the walls. To which fundamental duty does the given statement belong?

options.text: To safeguard public property and to abjure violence
To promote harmony and spirit of common brotherhood
To defend the country and render national service

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**To safeguard public property and to abjure violence**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **To safeguard public property and to abjure violence** is one of the fundamental duties listed in Article 51A of the Constitution of India.
 
• Writing on the walls of historical monuments is considered defacement and disrespect of public property, thus citizens are instructed to refrain from such actions.
 
• This duty emphasizes the importance of protecting and preserving public property and maintaining a civil and respectful attitude towards national heritage.
 
• It also aligns with the broader objective of promoting a sense of responsibility and discipline among citizens.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• It lays down the framework defining fundamental **political principles, establishes the structure, procedures, powers, and duties of government institutions**, and sets out fundamental rights, directive principles, and the duties of citizens.
 
• The Constitution of India is the **longest written** constitution of any country in the world.
 
• It declares India a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic, assuring its citizens justice, equality, and liberty, and endeavors to promote fraternity.**
 
• The **Seventh Schedule** of the Constitution contains three lists which delineate the subjects under the **Union, State, and Concurrent lists**.
 
• Amendments to the Constitution can be made through a process outlined in **Article 368**.
 
• The Union List has been amended several times to meet the evolving needs of the nation.

questions.question: _________ oblong orbit overlaps the orbit of Neptune.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Pluto's**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pluto's** oblong orbit overlaps the orbit of Neptune.
 
• Pluto is classified as a dwarf planet in the Kuiper belt, a ring of bodies beyond Neptune.
 
• The orbit of Pluto is highly elliptical, taking it inside the orbit of Neptune for 20 years of its 248-year orbit around the Sun.
 
• This unique orbital characteristic means that at certain times, Pluto is closer to the Sun than Neptune.
 
• Despite this overlap, there is no risk of collision due to their respective orbital inclinations and resonance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pluto** was discovered by Clyde Tombaugh in 1930 and was originally classified as the ninth planet of the Solar System.
 
• In 2006, the International Astronomical Union (IAU) redefined the criteria for planet classification, and Pluto was reclassified as a dwarf planet.
 
• Pluto has five known moons: Charon, Styx, Nix, Kerberos, and Hydra.
 
• The New Horizons mission, launched by NASA, performed a flyby of Pluto in 2015, providing the most detailed images and data of the dwarf planet to date.
 
• Pluto's surface is composed of a mixture of frozen nitrogen, methane, and carbon monoxide ices.
 
• It has a thin atmosphere that expands when it is closer to the Sun and collapses as it moves farther away.

questions.question: What are the standard measurements of a cricket pitch?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**22 yards by 10 ft**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The standard measurements of a cricket pitch are **22 yards (20.12 meters) in length** and **10 feet (3.05 meters) in width**.
 
• The pitch is the central strip of the cricket field where most of the action takes place.
 
• The length of 22 yards is also referred to as one chain in older imperial units.
 
• The pitch is marked with creases, including the bowling crease, popping crease, and return creases, which define the area within which the bowler and batsmen operate.
 
• The quality and preparation of the pitch can significantly affect the outcome of the game, influencing the behavior of the ball and the strategy of the teams.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Cricket is a sport that originated in England and is now played worldwide, particularly in countries like India, Australia, and South Africa.
 
• The game is played between two teams of eleven players each, with the objective of scoring more runs than the opposing team.
 
• There are different formats of cricket including Test matches, One Day Internationals (ODIs), and Twenty20 (T20) matches, each with its own set of rules and duration.
 
• Cricket pitches can vary in terms of hardness, grass cover, and moisture, leading to different playing conditions, often described as "fast," "slow," "dry," or "damp." These conditions can favor either the batsmen or the bowlers.
 
• Maintaining the pitch is a specialized task carried out by groundsmen, who use various tools and techniques to prepare the pitch before and during the game.

questions.question: What is the impact of proportional taxes?

options.text: Increases the marginal propensity to consume

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Reduces the autonomous expenditure multiplier**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Proportional taxes** are taxes that maintain a consistent rate regardless of income level.
 
• These taxes **reduce the autonomous expenditure multiplier** because they decrease disposable income, leading to lower consumption and investment.
 
• The **autonomous expenditure multiplier** is a measure of the change in aggregate output caused by a change in autonomous spending.
 
• When disposable income is reduced, the overall consumption in the economy decreases, thereby reducing the multiplier effect.
 
• In contrast, the **induced expenditure multiplier** is influenced by changes in income levels and marginal propensities to consume.
 
• Proportional taxes do not increase the induced expenditure multiplier; rather, they generally have a contractionary effect on the economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **marginal propensity to consume (MPC)** is the fraction of additional income that a household consumes rather than saves.
 
• Proportional taxes do not directly affect the MPC but can influence overall consumption patterns by reducing disposable income.
 
• Understanding the impact of different types of taxes on multipliers is crucial for designing effective fiscal policies.
 
• Fiscal policy tools, such as altering tax rates and government spending, are used to manage economic activity and achieve macroeconomic objectives.
 
• Effective fiscal policy can help stabilize the economy, promote growth, and reduce unemployment.

• It declares India to be a **sovereign, socialist, secular, and democratic republic**, ensuring justice, equality, and liberty for its citizens and promoting fraternity among them.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Preamble was adopted along with the Constitution on **26th November 1949** and came into effect on **26th January 1950**.
 
• The Preamble is not enforceable by law but plays a crucial role in the interpretation of statutes and provisions of the Constitution.
 
• It encapsulates the essence of the Constitution and the vision of its framers for the nation.
 
• The terms "socialist" and "secular" were added to the Preamble by the **42nd Amendment** in **1976**.

questions.question: What is the literacy rate of India as per the National Survey of India-2022?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**77.7%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **77.7%** is the literacy rate of India as per the National Survey of India-2022.
 
• The literacy rate measures the percentage of people aged 7 and above who can read and write with understanding.
 
• It is an important indicator of educational attainment and socio-economic development in the country.
 
• The survey conducted takes into account various demographic factors including age, gender, and region to provide a comprehensive overview of literacy in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The National Survey of India** is conducted periodically to assess various socio-economic indicators, including literacy rates.
 
• Efforts to improve literacy rates in India include various government initiatives like the Sarva Shiksha Abhiyan and the National Literacy Mission.
 
• Literacy is crucial for empowering individuals and enabling them to participate fully in the socio-economic development of the country.
 
• Continuous efforts are being made to bridge the literacy gap between different regions and demographic groups in India.

questions.question: Which does social networking service place the biggest emphasis on professional networking?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**LinkedIn**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **LinkedIn** places the biggest emphasis on professional networking.
 
• It is designed specifically for the business community, allowing users to create professional profiles, connect with colleagues, and search for jobs.
 
• LinkedIn also provides a platform for companies to post job openings and for professionals to showcase their skills and experience.
 
• It is widely used for networking, recruiting, and job searching within various industries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **LinkedIn** was founded in December 2002 and launched in May 2003.
 
• As of 2021, LinkedIn has over 774 million registered members from more than 200 countries and territories.
 
• LinkedIn also offers premium subscriptions that provide additional features such as enhanced search tools and the ability to send messages to people outside your network.
 
• It is a valuable tool for professionals looking to expand their network, discover job opportunities, and enhance their career development.
